name: IP Subnet Calculator API
shortDescription: Deterministic IPv4 CIDR math — subnet boundaries, usable host ranges, and overlap detection for network agents
description: Agent-native IPv4 subnet workflow. Given a CIDR, returns network and broadcast addresses, netmask and wildcard mask, usable host range, total/usable counts, and RFC1918 private-range detection — computed in real bitmask arithmetic (confidence always 1.0, never estimated). /overlap detects disjoint/identical/containment/partial relationships between two blocks for conflict-free allocation. The one-call /lookup combines a full subnet breakdown with an optional overlap check, a reasoning object, prioritized recommended actions, and chain_to pointers to IP geolocation and IP intelligence for per-host follow-up. Atomic, fast, and cheap for autonomous networking and IPAM agents.
